transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Well, I came in because... I've been having this issue with how I'm talking lately. Like at work, I'm a jeweler, and when a customer asks me a really simple question—like when a ring repair will be ready—my answer just goes all over the place. 

I'll start out talking about the invoices, and then somehow that turns into talking about garden soil, and then suddenly I'm on about mortgage papers. I can just see them losing me, like they have no idea what I'm saying. It's just getting really hard to communicate clearly, and I need to figure out what's going on.
Have you been hearing or seeing things that other people around you do not seem to notice?

Well, yes, actually. Um... sometimes when the shop is really quiet, I hear a woman muttering my name. It always sounds like it's coming from the polishing room. And... I also smell burning metal sometimes, even when all the torches are completely off. It feels so real that I actually get up and go check the back room to make sure nothing is on fire or that no one is back there. But there's never anyone else around.
Have you experienced any periods where your mood was extremely high or low, lasting for several days or weeks, at the same time you were having these experiences with the voices and smells?

Yes, I have. Um... there was a period, especially during the worst months, where I just felt this incredibly heavy sadness. I completely lost interest in everything, even my work, which I usually love. And... that was happening right at the same time I was hearing that woman muttering my name in the shop. It was also around then that I was just so sure that the customers were somehow checking up on our payments. It all just kind of happened at once.

Have you ever experienced these voices or the feeling that people were watching you during times when you felt completely normal, or perhaps even unusually energetic, rather than just when you were feeling that heavy sadness?

Yes, actually. Um... before that really heavy sadness started, there was a stretch where I felt pretty normal. I was still running my jewelry-making classes and working out in the garden like I usually do. But even then, for a few weeks, I kept hearing those muttering noises coming from the polishing room. And I was already having those thoughts that the customers were watching the business. So, yes, it was happening before I got so depressed.
Looking back at the times you were hearing those voices or feeling watched, was there ever a period of at least two weeks where you were not feeling depressed or particularly high-spirited?

Yes, exactly. Like I was just saying, there was a stretch before the depression really settled in. I was feeling totally fine, you know, just my normal self. I was still running my classes and working out in the garden. But for several weeks during that time, I kept hearing those noises from the polishing room. And I was already worrying that the customers were watching the business. So, yes, it lasted for a few weeks while my mood was completely normal.
